title: Shardhide Pouncer
text: Shardhide Pouncer flattens against broken glass and erupts only when prey steps across its shadow. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The reflection is empty because the hunter is underneath it.

defeatReward.text: Shardhide Pouncer is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
